meta.name: Allegiance
meta.description: A star rookie police officer must grapple with the limits of the justice system as she fights to exonerate her politician father and serve her diverse hometown of Surrey.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: At her graduation from the country’s top police Academy, Sabrina Sohal’s world is upset by a shocking, inexplicable arrest. She deals with the fallout while pursuing an Amber Alert on her first day.

videos.title: Supply Side
videos.overview: When a lawyer dies of an overdose, Sabrina and the team track a batch of deadly heroin sweeping through Surrey, leading to a grieving mother challenging the legal and moral limits of the war on drugs.

videos.title: Running on Empty
videos.overview: Sabrina joins a Serious Crimes investigation into an international car theft ring, finding herself getting behind the wheel to protect a former star athlete fallen on hard times.

videos.title: IRL
videos.overview: Sabrina and Vince respond to a gun call at a library, drawing them into a fast-paced case involving ghost guns, a looming sextortion deadline, and a desperate young man caught in the middle.

videos.title: Homecoming Kings
videos.overview: A manhunt for two dangerous brothers whose past crimes have left long-term scars on a community and a legacy of mistrust for the police, reveals regrets that still haunt Vince to this day.

videos.title: Safe Harbours
videos.overview: A call to a motel leads Sabrina and Vince into the underbelly of a migrant worker trafficking ring. Ishaan sends Kyle undercover to meet a white supremacist who may have insight into Ajeet’s arrest.

videos.title: The Legacy
videos.overview: When a young Indigenous woman has her baby taken by a social worker, Sabrina and Vince uncover a web of lies, leading to a race against time to find a newborn before she disappears forever.

videos.title: 8 X 6
videos.overview: A chance encounter with a recently released convict lands Sabrina centre stage in a murder interrogation where it seems only she can secure a confession in time.

videos.title: Fallen Idols (1)
videos.overview: A gang related drive-by shooting thrust Sabrina and Vince into the lives of a community volunteer trying to curb the violence, a gangster trying to escape it, and a teen eager to embrace it.

videos.title: Dawn to Dawn (2)
videos.overview: As Sabrina waits for the axe to fall on her career, she must do everything in her power to keep a troubled teen caught in a bloody gang conflict from becoming a killer.

videos.title: Unsee This
videos.overview: On Sabrina's first day at her job with Serious Crimes, her investigation into a woman's murder leads her into the sinister side of the tech world.

videos.title: Mad About You
videos.overview: Sabrina and Zak, new partners, investigate a pop star's death threat; they grieve a lost colleague; they disagree as they search for the culprit.

videos.title: The House Always Wins
videos.overview: A jewelry store robbery leads Sabrina into the predatory world of online gambling while a young man's life hangs in the balance.

videos.title: Daddy Issues
videos.overview: When a billionaire is found dead in his bathtub, Sabrina and Zak's investigation has them navigating the world of the .01 percent, feuding sisters, and people living on the margins.

videos.title: The Vow
videos.overview: When a groom is stabbed at a lavish Indian wedding the attempted murder is just the tip of the iceberg as multiple motives are uncovered.

videos.title: Shine a Light
videos.overview: A violent home invasion reveals a complex immigrant family dynamic.

videos.title: Shelter from the Storm
videos.overview: A man is killed with a mysterious weapon and as their investigation unfolds, Sabrina and Zak go into the world of the unhoused.

videos.title: We Were Winning
videos.overview: When a junior hockey team owner is gunned down after a championship game, the motive leads Sabrina and Zak to unexpected places.

videos.title: Do No Harm
videos.overview: The robbery of a cancer pharmacy leads to a surprising connection with a newly grieving widow.

videos.title: Mercy's End
videos.overview: Sabrina's instinct takes her on a rogue investigation that lands her in peril, putting her skills, intellect, and instinct to the biggest test yet.
